entities.name: Hadamar Euthanasia Centre
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Hadamar killing centre was a killing facility involved in the Nazi involuntary euthanasia programme known as Aktion T4. It was housed within a psychiatric hospital located in the German town of Hadamar, near Limburg in Hessen.
